name: Chipata

queries.query: site:gov.zm Chipata cadastral map parcel Zambia land registry GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Zambia Ministry of Lands public National Spatial Data Infrastructure ArcGIS cadastre service, the Chipata City Council site and a current official Chipata land-audit notice. The ArcGIS service exposes a public Lots layer with safe parcel IDs and geometry.

queries.query: mapu a malo a Chipata Zambia cadastral chiwanja kaundula boma
queries.result: First-party discovery returned the official Chipata City Council land-audit notice and official Chipata planning material; the search did not expose a separate local-language parcel viewer. The national first-party NSDI cadastre service was then tested directly as the public map/API source.

registryEvidence.custodian: Chipata City Council for local land/planning administration; Zambia Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources / National Spatial Data Infrastructure for the public national cadastre service.
registryEvidence.scope: The council source evidences local land-audit and planning responsibility. The Ministry NSDI ArcGIS service is a national public cadastre source containing a Lots layer described as lots from ZILMIS; this is source evidence, not runtime admission.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: Local council custody and national service are kept distinct. General national agency prose was not treated as local custody.

parcelDiscovery.crs: EPSG:32735 source layer; GeoJSON response requested as EPSG:4326

boundedResponse.query: 10 km UTM envelope around exact WUP point
boundedResponse.note: The bounded envelope intersected 29 lots, of which three full polygons were retained. Exact-point zero is not treated as absence.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: Official ArcGIS service metadata returned. Service spatial reference is EPSG:32735; Lots layer is polygonal, supports JSON/GeoJSON/PBF and advertises lots from ZILMIS.
Lots layer schema returned. Native safe identity candidate is SDE.Lots.UPID (Plot ID); OBJECTID, PID, SRREF and other source fields were observed but not retained in sample properties.
Anonymous exact-point query returned an empty FeatureCollection; not used as an absence conclusion.
Anonymous bounded envelope query returned 29 polygon features. Three full polygons with native UPID identities were retained after removing unsafe/source-specific attributes.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: ArcGIS REST service directory and layer metadata; no separate viewer configuration required

safeFieldAllowlist: source CRS and requested output CRS

qualification.reason: A real public anonymous parcel response with native UPID identifiers and polygons was retrieved, but runtime adapter admission remains held pending independent serial review.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point and latitude/longitude order were preserved; no coordinate shift was made.
The 10 km envelope is bounded evidence, not proof of citywide coverage or absence.
The public service metadata says lots from ZILMIS; completeness, update cadence and legal/status semantics were not independently verified.
Packet completion is research completion only and does not admit or integrate a runtime source.
uncertainty: Citywide parcel coverage, completeness outside the tested envelope, update cadence and whether every UPID is globally stable across service revisions remain unresolved. The retained sample uses the service's EPSG:4326 output geometry, while the source layer is EPSG:32735.
